decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans QP/1133/P01, QP/1133/P02 Revision A, Design and Access Statement, and BSkyB Travel Plan received 22nd July 2010 and P155-1024R1, D2197-E-01 Rev A and QP/1133/P02 received 17th August 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The approved use shall be for a limited period of three years expiring on 30/09/2013 when the use shall cease.
Condition : 4 - There shall be no more than 200 marked car parking spaces on the site at any time.
description: Change of use from ancillary lorry park to staff car park for BSkyB incorporating surfacing, lighting, planting and access
